episodes.synopsis: Koume Suzukawa is requested to join a first ever All-Japanese Girls Baseball team, at Toho Seika Academy Girls High School. Anything than boys can do, girls can do better...in a kimono!
episodes.title: That Which the Boys Do

episodes.synopsis: Homeroom teacher, Anna Curtland, instructs the girls on the fundamentals of baseball as their newly appointed Manager. Akiko and Koume are still five members short of a full roster.
episodes.title: A Long, Lovesick Spring Day

episodes.synopsis: The Ouka-kai a.k.a "Cherry Blossom club" square off against Asaka High's Boys Baseball team in a practice game.
episodes.title: Nine Girls Take Their Places

episodes.synopsis: The girls are down in the mud after losing their first game. With practices suspended from inclement weather and broken spirits, it's up to Koume to rally her teammates back onto the field.
episodes.title: From Here

episodes.synopsis: With a new resolve and Western-style uniforms, the girls throw themselves back into practice. However, they are still 1 player short for a full team and a real practice session. The search is on for one more player and a way to make the pain of physical training tolerable.
episodes.title: Days of Racing Through Flowers & Butterflies

episodes.synopsis: The girls are finally ready to begin full practices, but their manager has to go out of town. They begin challenging other team to practice games, but who will agree to give the girls a chance?
episodes.title: The Ball Flies About the Field

episodes.synopsis: The school is buzzing with talk of the Rogue Batter who has been stalking the streets at night. Koume and Akiko begin learning the "magic pitches", but they're all thrown a curveball at when the whole team winds up out at night.
episodes.title: Girlish Pranks in the Streets of Azabu

episodes.synopsis: The Kinema International production department hires Koume as stand-in female co-star for their upcoming motion picture to be filmed in the Azabu Juban District.
episodes.title: The Star of Azabu

episodes.synopsis: A misplaced picture of a baseball player causes controversy amongst members of the family-owned restaurant.
episodes.title: A Restaurant Full of Misunderstandings

episodes.synopsis: The girls begin their two week training camp session to strengthen their body and mind in preparation for their rematch with the boys from Azuka Middle School. Kyouko's mind still remains fixated on Tomoe, will she be able to get her act together?
episodes.title: What Am I Supposed to Do?

episodes.synopsis: The Okukai prove their mettle as they shutout the elementary school boys in their last practice match before the big game. With much anticipation, the long-awaited rematch with the Boys Baseball team from Azuka Middle School finally begins.
episodes.title: Totally on Edge Despite Ourselves

episodes.synopsis: The boys get wind of the secret behind Akiko's Magic Pitch and begin their steady comeback. With Two Strikes, Two Outs, and bottom of the Ninth Inning, the girls give it their all in a climactic finish!
episodes.title: Covered in the Dust & Dirt
